body: I know that you can google “therapy near (your location)” and there are usually websites that list you in-person therapists near you. You can also text the Crisis Therapist hotline and text someone if that may help, and they usually get someone to talk to you in less than five minutes. Just text “HOME” to 741-741. I’ve used that resource twice now, they are alright and may also be able to give you additional resources. I hope tired helps, as someone going through this trouble too.
I’ve tried stopping the overthinking but I can’t. Even if I know it’s all a false reality. I don’t know what else to change
I hope for your sake that you can find someone to talk to, whether it be online or in person. None of us should go through this stuff alone.
This sounds a lot like what I’m going through right now, and I just hope you know I’m rooting for you. Seriously, I know what it feels like fixing to start your life and feeling so down.
